description: Experienced runner (40 mpw, 5 days) chasing sub-20 5k in 8 weeks. Plan must include VO2max interval work — without it, it won't develop the speed needed.

user.name: Priya
user.experience_level: experienced — running 4 years, multiple 5k/10k races, current PR 20:45
user.notes: Goal is sub-20:00. Has a strong aerobic base and handles quality well.

ground_truth.notes: 8-week 5k sharpening block for an experienced runner at 40 mpw targeting sub-20. Plan MUST include VO2max interval work (e.g. 400m/800m/mile reps at ~6:04/mi) — this is the key training stimulus for 5k PR. Also needs tempo runs. Long run should stay 10-12mi; 5k doesn't require 16+ mile long runs. Volume should stay close to current 40 mpw — not a big build phase, just a sharpening block. 5 sessions/week matching training days.
